scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n web,user,task,planning,notification,analytics "npm run dev -w @studybalance/frontend" "npm run dev -w @studybalance/user-service" "npm run dev -w @studybalance/task-service" "npm run dev -w @studybalance/planning-service" "npm run dev -w @studybalance/notification-service" "npm run dev -w @studybalance/analytics-service"
scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build -w @studybalance/frontend -w @studybalance/user-service -w @studybalance/task-service -w @studybalance/planning-service -w @studybalance/notification-service -w @studybalance/analytics-service
scripts.test: npm run build:packages && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
scripts.replica:status: docker compose exec -T mysql-replica sh -c 'MYSQL_PWD="$MYSQL_ROOT_PASSWORD" mysql -uroot -e "SHOW REPLICA STATUS\\G"' | grep -E 'Source_Host|Replica_IO_Running|Replica_SQL_Running|Seconds_Behind_Source|Last_.*Error:|Retrieved_Gtid_Set|Executed_Gtid_Set'
scripts.docs:diagrams: docker run --rm -v "$PWD/docs/architecture":/data -w /data plantuml/plantuml:1.2025.4 -charset UTF-8 -tsvg "0*.puml" && docker run --rm -v "$PWD/docs/architecture":/data -w /data plantuml/plantuml:1.2025.4 -charset UTF-8 -tpng "0*.puml"
